name: DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Prim.execA_corr
typeText:
∀ {m : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Mem} {a : Array.{0} Nat},
  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Corr m a →
    ∀ (p : DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Prim),
      DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Corr (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Prim.exec p m)
        (DisequalityDispersion.Machine.Prim.execA p a)

source.code:
theorem Prim.execA_corr {m : Mem} {a : Array ℕ} (h : Corr m a) (p : Prim) : Corr (p.exec m) (p.execA a) := by
  cases p <;> simp only [Prim.exec, Prim.execA, h _] <;> exact h.write _ _
